summary: Frontend-only testing of the new /my-challenges page + updated side/bottom nav. All 6 review points verified with mocked APIs. My Chal sits directly below Trade on the desktop rail, is highlighted green when active. Running is default tab. Tabs correctly filter (Running=1, Complete=0, Failed=1) with count badges. Basic running card shows balance $1,120.00, days '6 of 13 days left', and profit-target bar width EXACTLY 20% (12/60). Premium failed card shows Profit Target 0.00% with empty (0%) bar (no negative), and today-loss with limit_pct=null renders '/ no limit' with empty bar (no NaN). Empty state on Complete tab renders and 'Browse challenges' navigates to /challenges. Mobile bottom bar order (Chart, My Chal, Profile, Challenges, Logout) is correct with no History slot. My Chal from /demo-trade opens /my-challenges; Challenges from mobile opens /challenges. No horizontal overflow at 414x820. Desktop rail contains the expected 6 items (Trade, My Chal, Challenges, Profile, Help, Settings) on all TerminalShell pages and on the DemoTrade page (rail visible in screenshot).

minor.issue: days_left formula: `(ends_at - now).days + (1 if (ends_at - now).seconds and ends_at > now else 0)` will over-count by 1 in some cases and can behave unexpectedly if ends_at is in the past (timedelta.days becomes negative, .seconds is still non-negative). max(0, ...) partially masks this. Prefer math.ceil((ends_at - now).total_seconds() / 86400) when ends_at > now, else 0.

State derivation only considers ends_at expiry as 'failed' when no target and profit_pct<target; it never derives 'complete' from an in-time balance meeting target unless c.status is already 'passed'. That path is fine, but note that if ends_at <= now and target is 0, it's labeled 'complete' regardless of PnL — likely unintended.

today's PnL is filtered by `Order.status != 'open'` and `Order.settled_at >= day_start`, but Order.settled_at may be NULL for still-open orders — safe. However tz assumption: day_start uses UTC midnight; if the user is in a different timezone the 'Today' bar rolls at the wrong time. Consider a user-configurable trading day.
loss_pct is computed against account_size which is fine, but max_loss rule sometimes is defined as % of starting balance minus fees — verify ACCOUNT_PLANS rules match the marketing copy.

daily_loss_pct falsy-check: `float(daily_loss_pct) if daily_loss_pct else None` will also treat 0 as null (rendering 'no limit') — should be `None if daily_loss_pct is None else float(daily_loss_pct)`.

action_items: (minor) Refine days_left math in backend to ceil-based calculation guarded against negative timedeltas.
(minor) Fix daily_loss_pct falsy handling in /api/challenges/mine so that 0 is treated as an explicit 0% limit rather than 'no limit'.
critical_code_review_comments: MyChallenges.jsx Meter floors negative % (Math.max(0,...)) — good; also gracefully renders 'no limit' when limit is falsy. No mongodb _id concerns (SQLAlchemy backend).
TerminalShell SIDE_ITEMS and MobileNav ITEMS match the requested order exactly.

data-testid for rail includes a space ('side-my chal', 'mobile-nav-my chal') because it is derived from label.toLowerCase(); works but a space in a testid is fragile — consider using slugified labels.
